title: Vikram and Betal: The Kind Prince
moral: Kindness is more valuable than riches.

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a kind prince.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a prince who always helped others.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.summary: The prince helps an old man.
scenes.text: The prince helped an old man carry a heavy load.
scenes.image_prompt: prince helping old man carry load cartoon

scenes.summary: The prince shares food with a child.
scenes.text: The prince gave all his food to a hungry child.
scenes.image_prompt: prince giving food to child cartoon

scenes.summary: The prince is left with nothing.
scenes.text: The prince had no food left but felt happy.
scenes.image_prompt: prince sitting tired but smiling cartoon

scenes.text: Vikram said kindness comes from the heart. Betal flew away again.
scenes.image_prompt: betal flying away while vikram stands calm cartoon

story: A kind prince helped others even when he had little. He shared his food and effort selflessly. Vikram said true kindness comes from the heart, and Betal flew away.
